name: Pipeliners - Local Page Strengthen Drafts 2026-10-09
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-10-09

# Summary
"Strengthen this ranking page" packages for five city pages, prepared Oct 9, 2026 (drafts only; nothing written live). Built from a GSC shortlist (Domain property, last 28 days, 34 city pages, 752 query rows) after excluding ad-touched pages (/gilbert/, /cave-creek/, /san-tan-valley/, /fort-mcdowell/, /mesa/), Kim's exclusions (/anthem/, /apache-junction/) and Maricopa (in test).

# Key findings
- Batch 1 (ad-free, close to page 1): Florence, Buckeye, Sun City, Avondale, Goodyear. Batch 2: Sun City West, Paradise Valley, Fountain Hills, Coolidge, Laveen, Litchfield Park, Queen Creek. Big demand but far back: Chandler, Mesa, Tempe, Phoenix, Peoria, Scottsdale.
- Every draft has the same nine parts: live snapshot (desktop and Googlebot mobile), why this keyword, alignment table, exact new copy with Elementor insertion points, FAQ additions, internal links, rule-violation fixes, external link 200-twice log, risks and open questions.
- Focus keywords: Buckeye "pipe break repair in Buckeye" (pipe break cluster 154 impressions, more than double the others; the live title and meta never said "pipe break"); Florence "pipe break repair in Florence, AZ" (100 impressions at 10.3); Sun City "sewer line repair in sun city az" (103 at 24.7); Goodyear and Avondale "trenchless sewer repair in {City}, AZ".
- None of the five had a true 40 to 60 word answer block; the Sep 29 question headings were followed by 90 to 130 words of general copy.
- Goodyear was only 49% unique against /gilbert/ on 8-word shingles. Schema hours and rating had already been removed Oct 8.

# Decisions and status
- Blocker: the Google Ads ad check could not run (token expired Oct 9). Pages stay protected until the ad check shows 0 impressions or Kim gives a one-off OK.
- Avondale went a different way: it was fully rebuilt Oct 10 (see the Avondale keyword research note).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `gsc-shortlist-2026-10-09.md`, `avondale-draft.md`, `buckeye-draft.md`, `florence-draft.md`, `goodyear-draft.md`, `sun-city-draft.md`.
- `live/`: saved text trees, HTML and Elementor JSON of the five pages.
